xiaojingSidebar.resizeHint: Drag to resize, double-click to reset
xiaojingSidebar.emptyBrand: This brand has no sessions yet
xiaojingSidebar.deleteScope: This deletes {{sessionRecords}} session index record(s) and {{chatTranscripts}} chat transcript(s). It retains {{knowledgeFacts}} brand fact(s), {{operations}} operation(s), {{artifacts}} artifact(s), {{publishOrders}} order(s), and {{observations}} observation(s).
xiaojingSidebar.brandDeleteScope: This permanently deletes everything about the brand: {{sessions}} session(s) with {{chatTranscripts}} chat transcript(s), {{knowledgeFacts}} brand fact(s), {{operations}} operation(s), {{articles}} article(s), {{materials}} material(s), and {{monitorPlans}} active monitoring plan(s).
xiaojingSidebar.brandDeleteIrreversible: This action cannot be undone; no brand data can be recovered afterwards.

deleteFailed.in-use: The session has other work in progress and cannot be deleted right now. Try again later.
deleteFailed.busy-replying: The session is still responding. Stop the response or wait for it to finish before deleting.
deleteFailed.monitor-active: A post-publish monitor created by this session is still running (including paused). Handle the monitor plan on the Effect page before deleting.
deleteFailed.transition-in-progress: The session is still opening. Try again shortly.
deleteFailed.activity-unavailable: Session activity cannot be verified right now. Try again shortly.
deleteFailed.unexpected: Delete failed. Please retry; if it keeps failing, restart the app.
